subject: Helios evaluation: runway recalibration & MAP stewardship
messages:
From: Karen Liu <karen.liu@helioshealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: 2026-09-30T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Helios MAP + schedule note

Hi Rishi / Laura,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. The internal eval team did a quick sync this morning and we need to flag a likely shift in our acceptance window. Two items:

1) The clinical data ingest work is running behind (vendor delays) so our final validation is at risk of slipping by ~2 weeks.
2) Procurement is asking for an explicit MAP that ties milestones to payment tranches and a short risk log they can attach to the SOW.

I've attached the current MAP (Helios_MAP_v3.xlsx) — the dates in column C are the originals. Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept a revised acceptance window and provide a short risk log we can include in the SOW?

We'd like to avoid formal escalation but need a go/no-go for the new window by EOD Friday if possible.

Best,
Karen
Karen Liu
Program Manager, Clinical Integrations
Helios Health
[Attachment: Helios_MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Karen Liu <karen.liu@helioshealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, camila_reyes@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-30T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Helios MAP + schedule note

Karen — thanks for flagging this. We can accommodate a re-baseline but want to be explicit about the mitigations and the escalation path so procurement has a single artifact to attach to the SOW. Proposed approach:

- Short risk log (we'll provide) that captures root cause, impact to acceptance date, and contingency triggers.
- Revised MAP with new milestone dates and two fallback lanes (canary rollback + reduced-scope pilot).
- A one-week credit-neutral SLA buffer if Helios hits the new date and we experience infra-related issues during final validation (protects both sides).

Next steps from Redwood:
1) I'll draft the risk log and the MAP re-baseline and send for your review by tomorrow EOD.
2) Camila (CS lead) will outline the pilot/scope reduction options you could choose if the vendor delay persists.
3) Laura will confirm any procurement-facing wording for the SOW attachment.

Can you confirm whether procurement needs the document as a tracked-change Word or if a stamped PDF is sufficient? That will determine the final delivery format.

I am marking this as a potential map slippage — if we can't get sign-off by Friday we'll escalate to the account exec so we can secure temporary priority for infra.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
[Sent from mailbox: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai]

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, camila_reyes@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: 2026-09-30T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Draft risk log + re-baseline template (for Karen)

Team — drafting the procurement-friendly artifacts now. Key risk log entries I'm including:

- Risk ID: RL-01 | Title: Vendor data ingest delay | Owner: Helios vendor | Impact: +10–14 days to final validation | Trigger: missing daily batch for 3 consecutive days | Mitigation: Redwood to accept staged validation + pilot environment; contingency lane = reduced-scope pilot (Core clinical flows only).

- Risk ID: RL-02 | Title: Late test data delivery (format mismatch) | Owner: Helios integration team | Impact: 3–5 days | Trigger: schema mismatch in >5% of records | Mitigation: automated schema remediation script + joint runbook; pre-validation window extension of 48 hours.

- Risk ID: RL-03 | Title: Infra pre-warm shortfall | Owner: Redwood infra | Impact: performance degradation during load tests | Trigger: GPU pool under-provisioned at scheduled test start | Mitigation: temporary dedicated burst capacity and canary fallback to quantized model.

I attached a CSV stub (slippage_risk_log.csv) and a suggested paragraph for the SOW that ties milestone payment to the acceptance checklist and the triggers above.

Questions:
- Rishi: confirm whether the one-week SLA buffer language is acceptable to include verbatim.
- Camila: include two alternative pilot scopes (A/B) with clear acceptance criteria so Helios can pick.
- Grace: can you pre-authorize the temporary burst capacity if we need it (we'll only trigger with exec approval)?

If everyone signs off, I'll merge into the MAP spreadsheet and send an external draft to Karen by tomorrow EOD.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Solution Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: slippage_risk_log.csv (CSV)]

From: camila_reyes@redwood.ai

Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-30T14:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Draft risk log + re-baseline template (for Karen)

All good from CS. Two quick notes:
- Pilot A (reduced-scope): Core clinical ingestion + inference pipeline; acceptance = 95% match on sample set.
- Pilot B (canary): Full schema but limited traffic (20%) for 7 days; acceptance = stability + latency SLAs met.

I'll prepare both acceptance checklists and attach them to the MAP. Approve the SLA buffer language — it's standard and avoids back-and-forth with procurement.

Camila
Camila Reyes
Customer Success Lead
Redwood Inference

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Karen Liu <karen.liu@helioshealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, camila_reyes@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, procurement@helioshealth.com
Date: 2026-10-05T17:42:00-07:00
Subject: Helios MAP & risk log — proposed re-baseline and next steps

Karen — attached is the consolidated package: revised MAP with two fallback lanes and the procurement-ready risk log (see attachments). Summary:

- Revised final acceptance: 2026-11-18 (original: 2026-11-04) — net +14 days.
- Triggers: vendor missed daily batch x3 (RL-01) or schema failure >5% (RL-02) move to reduced-scope pilot.
- Contingency: Infra burst capacity & canary quantized model available on request; will require exec approval to trigger.
- SLA buffer: one-week operational buffer for post-acceptance infra stabilization (credit-neutral, limited to infra incidents).

Action items for Helios:
- Procurement: confirm format (Word tracked vs PDF) by 10/07 so we can finalize the SOW attachment.
- Helios Integration Lead: pick Pilot A or B by 10/08; if neither chosen, default = Pilot A.

If we do not get procurement confirmation by COB 10/07 we will trigger a one-time expedited review and notify account director to request priority capacity; that will be an escalation path only to be used if the revised date cannot be accepted.

Links: HubSpot deal HL-2026-0421 (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/HeliosHealth) and shared draft (https://redwood-cloud.share/doc/HL-0421/MAP-v3).

Attached: Helios_MAP_v3.xlsx (revised), slippage_risk_log.csv

Thanks — looking forward to your confirmation.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
